name: Single-leg calf raises
prompt: A trail runner, wearing loose, fully-covering outdoor running layers (long sleeves, leggings or joggers) and trail running shoes, performs bodyweight single-leg calf raises facing the camera, standing tall on the right foot with the left foot tucked behind the right ankle, the left foot resting against the back of the right calf and staying there the entire time so it cannot swing or kick, hands resting on the hips, their face clearly visible and unobstructed: the only movement is the right heel lifting straight up off the ground so the whole body rises a few inches onto the ball of the right foot, pausing briefly at the top, then the right heel lowering back down to the ground; the legs stay straight, the torso stays upright and still, there is no hopping and no leg swinging or kicking of any kind, in a flat mossy clearing just off a forest trail, sunlight filtering through the canopy in dappled patches, tall evergreen trees surrounding the clearing, a gentle river visible through the trees nearby, morning mist. Cinematic, polished outdoor lifestyle video, natural light, shallow depth of field, filmed from a single fixed camera position the entire time — the camera never moves and the subject never turns, reorients, or changes position relative to the camera. They repeat the full motion continuously, four to five complete repetitions, all from this one consistent angle. Vertical video, about 6 seconds, one continuous shot, photorealistic, G-rated, no on-screen text or watermark.

name: Cossack squats
prompt: A trail runner, wearing loose, fully-covering outdoor running layers (long sleeves, leggings or joggers) and trail running shoes, performs Cossack squats facing the camera in a wide stance with the feet about twice shoulder-width apart and the toes pointing slightly outward, their face clearly visible and unobstructed the entire time, hands clasped together in front of the chest: shifting the hips to the right and sinking deep into a squat on the right leg with the right knee bent and the right foot flat on the ground, while the left leg stays completely straight with the left foot flat or the left toes lifted pointing up, then pushing back up through the right foot to the center, and then shifting to the left and sinking into a deep squat on the left leg with the right leg straight, alternating sides smoothly with each repetition, in a flat mossy clearing just off a forest trail, sunlight filtering through the canopy in dappled patches, tall evergreen trees surrounding the clearing, a gentle river visible through the trees nearby, morning mist. Cinematic, polished outdoor lifestyle video, natural light, shallow depth of field, filmed from a single fixed camera position the entire time — the camera never moves and the subject never turns, reorients, or changes position relative to the camera. They repeat the full motion continuously, alternating sides, two complete repetitions per side, all from this one consistent front-facing angle. Vertical video, about 6 seconds, one continuous shot, photorealistic, G-rated, no on-screen text or watermark.
